name: When should I call a professional for drafty window repair?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a professional for drafty window repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider calling a professional for drafty window repair if you've identified significant drafts, notice visible damage to window frames, or if your energy bills are unusually high. While minor caulking can be a DIY task, complex issues like warped frames, extensive wood rot, or persistent drafts after basic fixes often require expert attention. A professional assessment ensures the root cause is correctly identified and effectively resolved, especially in Bay Area homes where various window types are common.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional for significant drafts, visible frame damage, high energy bills, or if DIY fixes aren't effective.
